# Data acquisition API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

One kind of data recorded in a session, such as electrophysiology, imaging or video, and where it is stored.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisition/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/dataacquisition/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `data_acquisition` (detail, create, update), `data_acquisitions` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `session` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [DataAcquisition type](/api/schemas/dataacquisition/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.

Form-only inputs (sent on create or update, not returned in responses):

- `experimental_interfaces` **[required]**.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `session` | [`session`](/api/stem/session/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `interfaces` | list of [`experimentalinterface`](/api/modules/experimentalinterface/) ids; nestable |
| `equipment` | list of [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/) ids |
| `type` | one of the [DataAcquisition types](/api/schemas/dataacquisition/) **[required]** |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |
| `image` | string; max 100 characters |
| `order` | number; nullable. Determines the order items are listed. |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisition/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('dataacquisition', load_all=True)
records = resp['data_acquisitions']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('dataacquisition', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.data_acquisitions;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "data_acquisitions": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "notes": "",
            "session": "<session-id>",
            "interfaces": [
                "<experimentalinterface-id>"
            ],
            "equipment": [
                "<equipment-id>"
            ],
            "type": "Audio",
            "details": {
                "...": "see the schema of the selected type"
            },
            "type_schema_version": "set by the server",
            "image": "",
            "order": 1
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisition/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('dataacquisition', data={"session": "<session-id>", "type": "Audio", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}, "experimental_interfaces": ["<experimentalinterface-id>"]})
record = resp.json()['data_acquisition']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('session', '<session-id>', 'type', 'Audio', 'details', struct(), 'experimental_interfaces', {{'<experimentalinterface-id>'}}), 'dataacquisition');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.data_acquisition;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisition/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('dataacquisition', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['data_acquisition']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('dataacquisition', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.data_acquisition;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "data_acquisition": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "notes": "",
        "session": "<session-id>",
        "interfaces": [
            "<experimentalinterface-id>"
        ],
        "equipment": [
            "<equipment-id>"
        ],
        "type": "Audio",
        "details": {
            "...": "see the schema of the selected type"
        },
        "type_schema_version": "set by the server",
        "image": "",
        "order": 1
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisition/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('dataacquisition', id='<id>', data={"notes": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'notes', 'new value'), 'dataacquisition', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisition/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('dataacquisition', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'dataacquisition');
```
